facts.fact: 她把赴约叫作「越狱成功」——没有 Finlay 她还把自己关在屋里。
facts.anchor: Really, I have Finlay to thank for the successful jailbreak from my home.

facts.fact: Louise 的绝交：电话进语音信箱、短信不送达、Blackberry 上凭空消失。
facts.anchor: My calls went straight to voicemail, my texts were never delivered – but sometimes that happened whenever she started dating someone new.

facts.fact: 她凌晨四点砸 Louise 母亲的门：对方说她交了新男友、搬走了。
facts.anchor: banging on her mum’s front door at four in the morning only to be told that she’d met someone and had moved out.

facts.fact: 人还活着、只是不想再理她——这种丧失比失恋更疼。
facts.anchor: The fact that she was still alive but just didn’t want to know me anymore only made the grief worse.

facts.fact: Nova 人格的起源：真我「无趣内向」不忍直视，只好扮演自信者。
facts.anchor: facing up to who I really was – quite dull and boring and introverted – was too painful to face.

facts.fact: 为装优雅点了 rosé，其实她恨一切葡萄酒——那味道让她想起 Luna 尿液的氨水味。
facts.anchor: In fact, I hate wine. I hate rosé wine, red, sparkling – even Prosecco.

facts.fact: 他开口就叫他 Cas——全世界只有父母和 Louise 这样叫过她。
facts.anchor: the only people to have ever called me Cas are my parents and Louise.

facts.fact: 她内心宣布：只要他能让她的人生好起来，此刻他想要什么她都答应。
facts.anchor: I want him to make my life extraordinarily better, so I’d probably agree to anything right now, regardless of what that involves or what he desires.
